title: The Jaeger article says JAEGER_LISTEN_HOST is meant to be 0.0.0.0 in a container and makes a snippet default the listening endpoints default, where the docs say it is useful when the container needs 0.0.0.0
goal: kb/public/logs/otel-collector-otlp-pipeline.md says what the Jaeger configuration page says about JAEGER_LISTEN_HOST: the snippet's hostname is localhost by default, overwritten via the variable, which is useful when a container needs 0.0.0.0, and does not say it is meant to be 0.0.0.0

run:
import re, sys
lines = open("kb/public/logs/otel-collector-otlp-pipeline.md", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
bad = [n for n, l in enumerate(lines, 1) if l.startswith("- ") and "[DOC" in l and "JAEGER_LISTEN_HOST" in l and re.search(r"meant to be", l)]
print("DOC lines saying JAEGER_LISTEN_HOST is meant to be 0.0.0.0:", bad or "none")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
